name: auto-ime
description: Auto switch input method based on code context using AST (Linux & Windows)

commands.title: Vim Escape and Switch to English

auto-ime.ibus.englishEngine.description: IBus engine name for English (find using 'ibus engine')

auto-ime.ibus.chineseEngine.description: IBus engine name for Chinese (find using 'ibus engine')

auto-ime.windows.pollingInterval.description: Windows IME state polling interval in milliseconds (lower = more responsive, higher = less CPU)

enumDescriptions: Auto: dual-keyboard layout switching when English(1033) + Chinese(2052) are installed, otherwise single-keyboard IME toggle
Dual keyboard: always switch keyboard layouts (requires an English keyboard layout)
Single keyboard: switch Chinese/English inside one IME by simulating the IME toggle hotkey
auto-ime.windows.strategy.description: Windows switching strategy. 'auto' keeps the classic dual-keyboard behaviour; 'single-keyboard' works with only a Chinese keyboard installed.

enumDescriptions: Shift: a lone Shift press toggles Chinese/English (default for Microsoft Pinyin on Windows 11)
Ctrl+Space: the classic IME toggle hotkey
auto-ime.windows.toggleKey.description: Hotkey used to toggle Chinese/English inside a single-keyboard IME. Must match the hotkey configured in your IME.
